capabilities: export a note as a single self-contained HTML file
embed images and formulas as Base64
generate a hierarchical table of contents that highlights the current section
choose between three export templates (v1, v2, v3)
open the output folder automatically after export
extras: README is mainly in Chinese with an English link; includes demo links and build/development notes (Node.js ≥ 16 required only for building from source).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a note into an offline single-file HTML page that can be shared or archived with styles, images and formulas intact.

relations.evidence: 复刻 Obsidian Fast Note Sync 分享页的阅读版式

summary: Exports notes to a single self-contained HTML file with embedded images and KaTeX formulas, using three selectable page templates.
